claims: The Houston Astros are scheduled to play the Los Angeles Angels on Thursday, March 27, 2026, at 8:15 PM ET at Daikin Park in Houston, TX.
The Los Angeles Angels defeated the Houston Astros 3-0 on Opening Day, March 26, 2026.
The March 26, 2026 game was the season opener.
Hunter Brown took the loss in the Houston Astros vs. Los Angeles Angels game on March 26, 2026.
Hunter Brown allowed 4 hits in 4 2/3 innings in the Houston Astros vs. Los Angeles Angels game on March 26, 2026.
Hunter Brown recorded 9 strikeouts in the Houston Astros vs. Los Angeles Angels game on March 26, 2026.
In the first inning of the Houston Astros vs. Los Angeles Angels game on March 26, 2026, a high drive to right field by Yordan Alvarez was ruled a foul ball.
The foul ball ruling on Yordan Alvarez's high drive to right field was upheld by video review.
Mike Trout homered for the Los Angeles Angels in the seventh inning against reliever AJ Blubaugh in the game on March 26, 2026.
